$comment: Single source of truth for business and legal details. Values in [square brackets] are placeholders and MUST be replaced before launch. Run `npm run check:business` to list any that remain. After editing, run `npm run build:legal` to regenerate the policies in the mobile app and website.
tagline: Manage your AI agents from your phone.
entityType: [e.g. private limited company / LLC / sole trader]
governingLaw: [e.g. the laws of England and Wales]
jurisdictionCourts: [e.g. the courts of England and Wales]
euRepresentative: [EU Art. 27 representative name and address, or 'Not appointed']
ukRepresentative: [UK representative name and address, or 'Not appointed']
hostingProvider: Replit, Inc. (website and privacy-request service hosting)
emailProvider: [YOUR EMAIL DELIVERY PROVIDER, e.g. your SMTP host]

pricing.summary: Crewdeck is free to download and use. There are no subscriptions, in-app purchases, ads, or hidden fees. You pay your AI provider (Anthropic) directly for API usage, at the rates they publish.
